en.headline: Adora Flora City to sail 19 Hong Kong home-port trips in 2027
en.dek: The cruise line said the ship will use Hong Kong as a home port for 19 sailings next year, after a November call and a New Year overnight voyage.
body: Adora Cruises said on Friday that its second large domestically built ship, Adora Flora City, will use Hong Kong as a home port for 19 sailings in 2027.

The company said the Hong Kong season will cover late March to early May, late June to the end of July, and late October to early November. Itineraries include five-day and six-day voyages to Vietnam and South Korea, longer Northeast and Southeast Asia sailings of nine and ten days, and three cruises with no port of call.

Adora said the ship is 341 metres long, with a gross tonnage of 141,900, 2,130 cabins and space for 5,232 passengers. It is due to begin its maiden voyage from Guangzhou's Nansha on 22 November, with Hong Kong as the first call, and to run a Hong Kong overnight sailing on 30 December.
Wen Wei Po reported that fares for the Hong Kong programme were listed from 1,150 Hong Kong dollars. The line said the 2027 deployment coincides with the 30th anniversary of the handover.

zh.headline: 愛達·花城號明年以香港為母港 營運19個航次
zh.dek: 愛達郵輪周五公佈，花城號明年將以香港為母港開出19個航次，並於十一月首航後到訪香港。
body: 愛達郵輪周五在香港公佈，第二艘國產大型郵輪愛達·花城號明年將以香港為母港，營運19個航次。
公司表示，香港航季分三段，為三月下旬至五月初、六月下旬至七月底，以及十月下旬至十一月上旬。航線包括前往越南及韓國的5天4晚和6天5晚航次，也有9天8晚及10天9晚的東北亞和東南亞長線，另有3個不設停靠港口的海上遊航次。
愛達指，花城號全長341米，總噸位14.19萬，設2130間客房及套房，可載客高達5232人。郵輪將於11月22日由廣州南沙母港開啟首航，首站到訪香港；12月30日另設香港跨年過夜航次。
文彙報報道，香港航線船票最低由1150港元起。公司表示，明年部署適逢香港回歸三十周年。
